name: omniauto-test
description: Cross-platform test automation framework for application

scripts.test:smoke:appium: E2E_DRIVER=appium PLATFORM=ios REPORT_DIR=reports npx wdio wdio.conf.ts --spec tests/smoke.e2e.ts
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),p=process.cwd();const s=path.join(p,'offline_library','applesimutils');const d=path.join(p,'node_modules','.bin','applesimutils');if(fs.existsSync(s)){try{fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(d),{recursive:true});fs.rmSync(d,{force:true});fs.symlinkSync(s,d,'file');console.log('[postinstall] linked applesimutils -> node_modules/.bin/applesimutils');}catch(e){console.warn('[postinstall] applesimutils link skipped:',e.message);}}else{console.log('[postinstall] skipping applesimutils (binary not found in offline_library)');}"
